events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary Beatles co-founder, singer, songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon was born on this day in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Imagine all the music... John Lennon would have been 86 today. What's your favourite solo track from the iconic Beatle?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British comedian, actor, and screenwriter John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Cleese of Mind
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from the comedy legend?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Legacy
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles dropped their iconic 'White Album'. Which track from this double LP is still on your playlist?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, in 1991.

angles.name: Queen's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, 35 years on. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' sixth studio album, 'Rubber Soul', was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Sound
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles gave us 'Rubber Soul'. A pivotal album that saw them evolve their sound. What's your top track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic passing of The Beatles' John Lennon in 1980.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, 46 years after his passing. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: The legendary innovator and 'Starman' David Bowie was born on this day in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's Universe
angles.copy: Celebrating the extraordinary life and artistry of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today. What's your favourite era of the Thin White Duke?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock & Roll, Elvis Presley, was born on this day in 1935.

angles.name: Long Live The King
angles.copy: Happy birthday to the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and rock legend Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! His riffs shaped rock 'n' roll forever. What's your favourite Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates his 82nd birthday.

angles.name: Forever Young
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the incomparable Rod Stewart! Still rocking and rolling after all these years. What's your go-to Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, known for hits like 'Our House' and 'Baggy Trousers', celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Madness Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the iconic frontman of Madness! One step beyond... what's your favourite track from the Nutty Boys?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop and soul singer Paul Young, known for 80s hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Young At Heart
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! Still got that soulful voice. What's your favourite 80s hit from him?

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary country music icon, singer-songwriter, and businesswoman Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday.

angles.name: Dolly's World
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the one and only Dolly Parton! A true legend of music and beyond. What's your favourite Dolly classic?

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman, singer-songwriter, and record producer Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That Talent
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Gary Barlow! From Take That to solo success, he's given us so many hits. What's your favourite Gary Barlow moment?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his string of 70s and 80s R&B and pop hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the fantastic Billy Ocean! Get outta our dreams and into our cars... with his greatest hits on repeat.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's first induction 38 years ago
events.blurb: The first-ever induction ceremony for the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame was held on this day in 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony. Who was your favourite inaugural inductee?
